_comment: GitHubPages scenario - the CIMD (Agent Governance) leg only, presenting the publicly hosted CIMD document (cimd/client-metadata.json, published by .github/workflows/publish-cimd.yml) instead of the one Client serves itself, so any partner's AS can fetch it without a tunnel. Client's own /client-metadata.json and /jwks.json are unused here - the AS fetches both from GitHub Pages. The published document is static: CimdDocumentUrl and RedirectUri below must match it character for character (CimdDocumentFactoryTests guards that), and keys/cimd-signing.pem must be the key whose public half is in cimd/jwks.json. Points at this repo's own Server/Keycloak for local testing, which needs orlandodev.github.io in the realm's CIMD permitted domains (see docs/keycloak-setup.md); change Server:Endpoint for a partner's MCP server.
